cases.upstreamName: reconnect on a temporary HTTP status still gives up after maxAttempts when every reconnect is a 503
cases.dartTest: stops retrying 503 responses at the attempt ceiling
cases.evidence: After the initial offset, repeated 503s fail at configured maximum and request count is checked.

cases.upstreamName: reconnect backoff rides out a restart with a budget
cases.dartTest: budget allows recovery after more than five failed reconnects
cases.evidence: A budget permits seven failed 503 reconnects and a final successful terminal event; zero delay keeps test deterministic.

cases.upstreamName: reconnect backoff rejects invalid backoff options
cases.dartTest: rejects invalid backoff options
cases.evidence: Rejects negative delays, negative attempts and zero budget; nonfinite JS numbers have no Dart Duration representation.

cases.upstreamName: reconnect backoff stops at the budget with initialDelayMs 0, after many tries
cases.dartTest: a zero-delay reconnect loop still expires its budget
cases.evidence: Zero-delay retries stop with a budget error; a separate pure backoff assertion checks 2,000 attempts.

cases.upstreamName: reconnect backoff keeps reconnecting for budgetMs when a budget is set
cases.dartTest: budget allows recovery after more than five failed reconnects
cases.evidence: Seven failed 503 reconnects precede recovery with budget and no implicit attempt ceiling.
